<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1379
Claimant:
Anthony Williams
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2023-08-24
Claim opened after the insured's vehicle was struck from behind at a traffic signal. The claimant is not represented by
a lawyer and reported a shoulder injury at first contact.
2023-08-29
The police report lists the claimant as a passenger in the vehicle and places responsibility for the rear impact on the
other driver. The officer's notes match the sequence of events the claimant described.
2023-09-30
Scene photos and statements from several witnesses have been received, and each describes the collision as the
claimant reported it. The other driver's account agrees on the point of impact.
2023-10-26
The driver is named on the policy, and coverage was in force when the loss occurred. Nothing in the file suggests any
of the damage happened before the policy started.
2023-11-09
The claimant gave a recorded statement describing the impact and the onset of shoulder pain, and it matched the first
report on every point. The same account has come up in each conversation since.
2023-11-20
Medical records show the injury pattern fits the force of the impact and the reported mechanism. Treatment followed a
usual course, and visits tapered off as the claimant's condition improved.
2023-12-03
A saerch of prior records found no earlier injury to the same shoulder. The claimant's regular provider has no record
of earlier complaints in that area.
2023-12-19
The repair appraisal shows major damage consistent with a rear impact. The appraiser has not yet determined
whether all of that damage came from this event.
2023-12-27
Records from an earlier claim with another carrier show the same major damage to this vehicle from an accident that
was never reported to this insurer. The damage is now being presented as new, and the file has been referred for
further review.
2024-01-19
The claimant was asked about the earlier records and said the prior event was minor and was not reported. The
explanation is consistent with the claimant's previous statements.
2024-02-02
The file remains open while the appraiser's supplemental report and an independent medical review are obtained. No
coverage decision has been made at this time.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
